claim_text: Evidence that biotin supplementation improves hair growth in people without established biotin deficiency is limited; high-dose biotin can also interfere with certain laboratory assays.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported supplementation and support context-specific evidence interpretation.

population.other_context: People considering biotin for hair concerns without known deficiency.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food sources and relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Biotin fact sheet summarizes limited evidence for cosmetic claims and laboratory assay interference.
limitations: Hair loss has many causes; clinical assessment may be needed and biotin use should be disclosed before testing.
Underlying evidence and exact source passages require full appraisal before approval.
